# bb-msm: box-local MSM offload service. Client + server are generated by
# ipc-codegen from msm_schema.jsonc, following the wsdb pattern.
set(MSM_SCHEMA ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/msm_schema.jsonc)
set(MSM_GEN_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated)
set(MSM_GEN_OUTPUTS
    ${MSM_GEN_DIR}/msm_ipc_client.cpp
    ${MSM_GEN_DIR}/msm_ipc_client.hpp
    ${MSM_GEN_DIR}/msm_ipc_server.hpp
    ${MSM_GEN_DIR}/msm_dispatch.hpp
    ${MSM_GEN_DIR}/msm_types.hpp
    ${MSM_GEN_DIR}/ipc_codegen/msgpack_adaptor.hpp
    ${MSM_GEN_DIR}/ipc_codegen/named_union.hpp
    ${MSM_GEN_DIR}/ipc_codegen/throw.hpp
)
set(IPC_CODEGEN_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../../ipc-codegen)
file(GLOB_RECURSE IPC_CODEGEN_SRC
    ${IPC_CODEGEN_DIR}/src/*.ts
    ${IPC_CODEGEN_DIR}/templates/cpp/*.hpp
)
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${MSM_GEN_OUTPUTS}
    COMMAND node --experimental-strip-types --experimental-transform-types --no-warnings
            ${IPC_CODEGEN_DIR}/src/generate.ts
            --schema ${MSM_SCHEMA}
            --lang cpp
            --out ${MSM_GEN_DIR}
            --client --server
            --cpp-namespace bb::msm_service
            --cpp-include-dir barretenberg/msm_service/generated
    DEPENDS ${MSM_SCHEMA} ${IPC_CODEGEN_SRC}
    COMMENT "Generating MSM IPC client + server from msm_schema.jsonc"
    VERBATIM
)
add_custom_target(msm_ipc_generated DEPENDS ${MSM_GEN_OUTPUTS})

# Client library: generated msgpack client. The strong definition of the MSM facade's
# weak IPC hook (msm_facade_client.cpp) is NOT in this archive — consumers compile it
# directly into their binary (see bb/CMakeLists.txt) so the symbol is always present
# without whole-archive linking, which the zig-driven release linker doesn't support.
add_library(
    msm_ipc_client
    STATIC
    ${MSM_GEN_DIR}/msm_ipc_client.cpp
)
add_dependencies(msm_ipc_client msm_ipc_generated)
target_include_directories(msm_ipc_client PUBLIC ${MSM_GEN_DIR})
target_link_libraries(
    msm_ipc_client
    PUBLIC
    barretenberg
    ipc_runtime
)

# bb-msm binary (standalone MSM server). Owns the resident SRS; executes requests
# through the standard MSM facade, so linking ecc_gpu (GPU preset) makes it a GPU
# server and otherwise it serves the CPU path.
add_executable(
    bb-msm
    main.cpp
    msm_handlers.cpp
    msm_ipc_server.cpp
)
add_dependencies(bb-msm msm_ipc_generated)
target_include_directories(bb-msm PRIVATE ${MSM_GEN_DIR})
target_link_libraries(
    bb-msm
    PRIVATE
    barretenberg
    ipc_runtime
    env
)
if(GPU)
    target_link_libraries(bb-msm PRIVATE "$<LINK_LIBRARY:WHOLE_ARCHIVE,ecc_gpu>")
endif()
if(ENABLE_STACKTRACES)
    target_link_libraries(bb-msm PUBLIC Backward::Interface)
    target_link_options(bb-msm PRIVATE -ldw -lelf)
endif()
